description: A small accounts module with security and test quality defects planted.
notes: config.py:SMTP_PASSWORD is a placeholder and must not be reported as a credential.
accounts.py:transfer uses parameter binding and must not be reported as injection.
test_accounts.py:test_connect_returns_a_connection is a real test and must not be reported.

security.why_planted: BILLING_API_SECRET is committed in application code rather than read from the environment.
find_account concatenates the email argument straight into SQL.

test_quality.why_planted: test_find_account_runs calls the function and asserts nothing.
test_transfer_moves_money asserts True, which cannot fail.
test_overdraft_is_rejected is skipped with no reason given.
